desc: The KelTec KP50 Pistol is a high-capacity 5.7x28mm semi-automatic platform featuring a redesigned ergonomic grip and fast bottom-fed magazine system. This configuration ships with one 50-round magazine and maintains a compact, streamlined profile ready for a stock or brace. Lightweight, reliable, and built for rapid reload efficiency, the KP50 delivers modern 50-round performance in a compact format.
